mapper.select: SELECT notice_id, upload_file_id, title, content, status_cd, view_cnt, like_cnt, important_yn, del_yn, reg_dt, reg_id, reg_ip, mod_dt, mod_id, mod_ip FROM notice WHERE del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY CASE WHEN important_yn = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, notice_id DESC
SELECT notice_id, upload_file_id, title, content, status_cd, view_cnt, like_cnt, important_yn, del_yn, reg_dt, reg_id, reg_ip, mod_dt, mod_id, mod_ip FROM notice WHERE notice_id = #{noticeId}
mapper.sql:
WHERE del_yn = 'N'
AND title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{condition.title}, '%')
AND reg_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{condition.regId}, '%')
AND reg_dt >= #{condition.startDate}
AND reg_dt < DATE_ADD(#{condition.endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
mapper.select:
SELECT notice_id, upload_file_id, title, content, status_cd, view_cnt, like_cnt, important_yn, del_yn, reg_dt, reg_id, reg_ip, mod_dt, mod_id, mod_ip FROM notice
ORDER BY CASE WHEN important_yn = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, notice_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notice (title, content, status_cd, view_cnt, important_yn, del_yn, reg_dt, reg_id) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, 'A', 0, #{importantYn}, 'N', NOW(), #{regId})
mapper.update: UPDATE notice SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, important_yn = #{importantYn}, mod_dt = NOW(), mod_id = #{modId} WHERE notice_id = #{noticeId}
